title: Linkage
tagline: Proves, with numbers instead of a citation, that stripping names from a dataset does not make it anonymous — by generating synthetic populations, running six real re-identification attacks against them, and scoring every attack against the ground truth it already knows

metrics.label: Re-identification attacks, every one scored against retained ground truth
Synthetic records rendered as one canvas field at 60fps
Tests across 20 files, including k/l/t checked against brute force
Ways to load a real dataset — no file input, no paste, grepped out of the build
